name: Adora Indigenous Nursing and Midwifery Scholarship
summary: Up to $15,000 for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander nursing and midwifery students in financial hardship.
who: In year one, two or three of the Bachelor of Nursing or Bachelor of Midwifery.
At least two trimesters of full-time study remaining.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Apply by Monday 22 March 2027, 4pm, for Trimester 1 2027.
